$description: Component registry for scripts/component-export (EXPORT-STANDARD.md section 7). One entry per exported component: where it lives in Figma and the hand-checked text the exporter can't read from Figma (purpose, rules, breakpoints, known issues). Edit this file when Karl changes a decision, then re-run the exporter.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Primary CTA button: the one preferred action on a page. Brand-primary fill, white Noto Sans Bold 16px Title Case label, optional 16px icon left or right.
rules: **Desktop** (`Breakpoint=Desktop`): the `Button` frame hugs its label and icons (HUG horizontally) inside the variant root, which keeps an 8px left/right margin. Buttons in a row or a stack keep a 16px gap.
**Mobile** (`Breakpoint=Mobile`): the `Button` frame fills the container width (FILL) inside the same 8px margin. Stacked buttons use an 8px gap.
**Height:** 40px in every state (8px top/bottom padding with a 40px min-height). It grows only when the label wraps to a second line.
The breakpoint split is Desktop vs Mobile only; there are no per-template variants (340/768/1024/1100/1280). Use Mobile below 640px and Desktop from 640px up unless a layout says otherwise.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
components.breakpoints:
| Breakpoint value | Viewport (MNG templates) | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop | ≥640px (768, 1024, 1100, 1280 templates) | The `Button` hugs its label and icons |
| Mobile | ≤639px (340 XS-Fold, 360 SM-Mobile templates) | The `Button` fills the container width, inside the 8px side margin |

*The viewport mapping is the export convention, not a Figma property; Figma only says Desktop / Mobile.*

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Small icon + label utility action (documented example: "Copy Link"). No box at rest; a 1px black border appears on Hover/Pressed. Figma set name: `Button Action`.
rules: Single size at every breakpoint (95×32, HUG). No Breakpoint property. It stays compact (32px), not 40px (Karl, 2026-10-02).
Width hugs icon + label; swapping the label changes the width.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Name swap (2026-10-02).** This documented set is `Button Action` (`7075:6357`). The older library set on the same page (`5417:3876`, formerly `Button Action`, kept for Reader Dashboard files) is now `Action Button`. The documentation frame keeps the page title "Action Button".

**Single-purpose reference.** This set only documents "Copy Link". The older `Action Button` library set bundles Resend Invitation, Link Copied, Share (Android/Apple/Unknown), Preview Most Recent, Save/Saved, Gift Article, Remove, Cancel and Delete as hidden layers, none exposed as variants. To render another action, swap the icon instance and the label text.
**Hidden trailing icon.** Every variant carries a hidden `Icon Right` (content_copy) after the label. It is never shown; ignore it when rendering.
**Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: Button Linkstyle
components.description: Text-link styled button (used for disclosures and inline CTAs such as "Forgot password?"). Underlined brand-primary text at rest; a 1px brand-primary box appears on Hover/Pressed. Optional 16px icon left or right of the label (`Icon` property, added 2026-10-15).
rules: Single size at every breakpoint. No Breakpoint property. It stays compact (38px with one line), not 40px (Karl, 2026-10-02).

**Width (Karl, 2026-10-15):** the button always hugs its label. It only gets narrower when other elements in the same parent container constrain it; then the label wraps onto more lines. In Figma the `Label` is Fill + auto height inside a Hug button. `Style=1 Row` has no max width; `Style=Stacked` shows the wrapped case with a max width of 91px (115px with an icon), so the label wraps at 75px. In CSS: `display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%;` on the button and `min-width: 0` on the label, never a fixed width.

**Icon (Karl, 2026-10-15):** `Icon` = None (default) / Left / Right. Every variant has the same layers, `Icon Left` / `Label` / `Icon Right`, with the unused icons hidden, so overrides carry across variant swaps. Icon container 16×16px (sample: `new-tab` from MNG Icons), always `color/gray/min` in every state (it does not follow the label color), 8px from the label (`spacing/100`), and centered vertically on the label however many lines it wraps to (`align-items: center`; icon `flex: none`). The Hover/Pressed box and the InFocus ring surround the label and icon together.
**Text alignment when the label wraps:** `Icon=Left` is left-justified; `Icon=None` and `Icon=Right` are right-justified.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (a 40px button reads as 46px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
**New-tab links:** the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`). A link that opens in a new tab also needs visually hidden text such as "(opens in a new tab)".
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

rules: Single size at every breakpoint (32×32 in every state). No Breakpoint property.
Sits in the modal header, top-right; see ModalsCenter in the main file.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (the 32px circle reads as 38px with the ring). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: In-Line Close
components.description: Close (X) button for in-line panels and alerts (InLineMessage, ModalsOffset). Bare 12px icon in a 40px hit area at rest; the 28px `Box` gets a white fill and 1px near-black border on Hover/Pressed.
rules: Single size at every breakpoint (40×40 hit area). No Breakpoint property.
Every state has the same layers (`Button` › `Box` › `Icon`); the `Box` has no fill or border in Default and InFocus.
Usually placed top-right of an InLineMessage panel, with the hit area aligned to the panel padding.

**Focus ring:** InFocus adds one `Focus Ring` frame, absolutely positioned 1px outside the element, with a 2px OUTSIDE stroke bound to `color/gray/black`. It draws outside the component and never changes its size or moves anything inside or around it (the ring surrounds the 40px hit area with 4px corners, matching the Hover/Pressed box). In CSS: `outline: 2px solid var(--mng-color-gray-black); outline-offset: 1px;` or an absolutely positioned pseudo-element; never a border or padding change.
knownIssues: **Margin not specified** (open spec gap, per the Figma Specifications column).

components.name: Non-Button Hyperlink
components.description: Plain in-text hyperlink (not a button). Brand-primary text with a 1px bottom border: dashed at rest, solid on Hover/Pressed, 2px teal box on InFocus. Figma set name: `Hyperlink`.
rules: Hugs its text at every breakpoint. No Breakpoint property.
Implement the underline as `border-bottom`, not `text-decoration` (that is how Figma builds it).

**Intentional, matches production (Karl, 2026-10-02):** 16.5px text, a teal (color/theme/primary) 2px focus box with 4px corners instead of the black ring, and the dashed underline kept inside the InFocus box (`Underline` › `Label`). Because the focus box is part of the layout, InFocus is 2px taller (25 vs 23px). Do not "fix" these.

components.name: Article Section Kicker
components.description: Section label above an article headline in For You cards, rows and the featured story: the article's section (articleSection), shown uppercase in the theme primary color.
rules: **Text:** the section name typed as written (`Section` text property); uppercase comes from the text case. One line.

**Type:** Noto Sans Bold 10 (`font/size/10`, `font/style/bold`), line height 12.5px (no line-height token yet), no letter spacing, matching the production top nav and Subscriber Only badge (Karl, 2026-10-23).
**Color:** `color/theme/primary`, so it changes per theme. Passes WCAG AA on white on all 96 sites (lowest 4.75:1, orlandosentinel.com).
**Size and spacing:** hugs its text, no padding. 8px (`spacing/100`) between it and the headline in For You cards and rows; 4px (`spacing/050`) in the featured story.
**Used in:** 1Col Article Card, Horizontal Thumbnail Card and Zone 1 Lead Article Card (`Style=For You`), as an exposed instance.
knownIssues: Line height 12.5px has no token.

components.name: Article Author
components.description: Author name in the footer of For You cards and rows and in the featured story byline.
rules: **Text:** the author's name as published (`Author` text property). One line; hugs its text.
**Type:** Noto Sans Medium 12 (`font/size/12`, `font/style/medium`), line height 16px (no line-height token yet). Color `color/gray/min` (18.4:1 on white).
**Cards:** the footer has a 1px `color/gray/500` top border and 8px (`spacing/100`) above the author; the Article Timestamp sits directly under it.
**Rows and the featured story:** author and timestamp side by side, 12px apart (`spacing/150`).
**Used in:** 1Col Article Card, Horizontal Thumbnail Card and Zone 1 Lead Article Card (`Style=For You`), as an exposed instance.

components.name: Zone 1 Lead Article Card
components.description: The homepage Zone 1 lead story (production lead with Related list); Gallery=Image or Gallery=Slideshow (a photo gallery lead, which shows the Zone 1 Slideshow instead of the image). The For You featured story is its own component, Blocks Lead Article Card (2026-10-28).
rules: **Headline and excerpt:** (Noto Serif Bold 29/33, −0.87px at 640px and up; 25/29, −0.03em below; excerpt Noto Sans 15/19 `color/gray/100`, 4px below the headline group on Desktop and Tablet, as in production).
**Layout:** Desktop and Tablet are two columns (text, then image; 20px and 32px apart); Mobile is one column (headline group, image, excerpt, Related list; 8px gaps) with a 1px bottom rule below.

**Gallery** (Karl, 2026-10-26): `Gallery=Slideshow` replaces the image with the Zone 1 Slideshow, as production does for gallery leads (`.feature-large .article-slideshow`). Zone 1 has no Gallery Icon Badge.

**Gallery=Slideshow layout follows the lead's width, not the screen:** two columns when the lead is about 700px wide or more (Desktop: text 295 and slideshow 356, the rest of the 706 card between them; Tablet: the slideshow fills the 358 column); one column when narrower: headline, excerpt, then the Related list, then the slideshow full width. On the homepage the third page column narrows the lead, so it is one column from 800 to 1279px (594 wide at 1024) and below 640px, and two columns from 640 to 799px and from 1280px up (production, checked on develop.denverpost.com 2026-10-26).

**The For You featured story** moved to Blocks Lead Article Card (Karl, 2026-10-28); its Style=For You variants were deleted. `Style` has one value (Standard) and is kept so existing instances don't change.

**Headline font follows the theme** (2026-10-30, Karl): bound to `font/theme/heading-family` (Noto Serif in Bold Coastal and Measured Vibrant, Noto Sans in Modern Earthy), like every other headline; it was bound to Noto Serif itself. The excerpt follows `font/theme/body-family`.

components.name: Zone 1 Slideshow
components.description: Inline slideshow a Zone 1 lead shows in place of its image when the story is a photo gallery. Breakpoint = Desktop, Tablet, Mobile; Show Credit (off by default), Slide Count and Caption text properties.
rules: **Image area:** 16:9 (Desktop 356×200, Tablet 358×201, Mobile 340×191); the photo is letterboxed and centered with no background.

**Controls breakpoint (production's):** large controls (40×60 arrows, 13px count and caption, Desktop spacing) at 800px and up; small controls below 800px. The Tablet variant shows the 768 template, so it uses the small controls; from 800 to 1023px use the large ones.

**Arrows:** previous and next, 40×60 at 800px and up and 35×53 below 800px, `color/gray/black` at 75% opacity, arrow-left / arrow-right icons in `color/gray/max` (30px; 26px below 800px), vertically centered at the image area's edges.

**Text:** credit (optional) Noto Sans Bold 11 `color/gray/200`; slide count Noto Sans Bold `color/gray/black`; caption Noto Sans Regular `color/gray/200`. Count and caption `font/size/13` at 800px and up, `font/size/11` below 800px; line height auto.

**Caption block:** 12px top (`spacing/150`); 8px between lines and 16px bottom at 800px and up (`spacing/100`, `spacing/200`); 4px and 12px below 800px (`spacing/050`, `spacing/150`); 3px `color/gray/500` rule along the bottom. 12px (`spacing/150`) below the slideshow.

**Arrow states** (Slideshow Arrow set `3641:50772`: Direction × Size × State): hover has no visual change (production sets the same colors; pointer cursor). Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`): 2px `color/gray/max` outline 3px outside the button, at the button's 75% opacity. Buttons have `aria-label` "Previous" / "Next".
**Behavior:** the gallery loops (Previous on slide 1 goes to the last slide), so production's disabled style (20% opacity) never shows. The image strip can be dragged or swiped. No dots or autoplay.
**Screen readers (required, not in production yet):** announce the slide count when the photo changes (`aria-live="polite"` on the count). Design-vs-production entry 17.2.
components.breakpoints:
| Lead width / viewport | Layout (set by the card) | Controls (production 800px breakpoint) |
|---|---|---|
| Lead about 700px or wider (homepage: 640–799px, 1280px and up) | Two columns: slideshow 356 (Desktop) or filling the 358 column (Tablet) | small below 800px, large from 800px |
| Lead narrower (homepage: below 640px, 800–1279px) | One column: slideshow full width after the text (and Related) | small below 800px, large from 800px |
knownIssues: Production type, spacing and colors are off-token: design-vs-production entry 17.1.
Production does not announce the slide count to screen readers (design-vs-production entry 17.2, required).
components.production: Production `article.slideshow.feature-large > .article-slideshow` (mng-gallery slider), seen on develop.denverpost.com.

components.name: Section Title / Eyebrow
components.description: Section header for homepage blocks and the For You feed. Style = Underline, Bold; Chevron (on by default), Show Subhead (off by default), Subhead text and Show Info properties.
rules: **Title:** the theme's eyebrow tokens (`font/theme/eyebrow-family`, `-size`, `-weight`: Bold Coastal Noto Sans 20 / 400, Measured Vibrant Noto Sans 17 / 700, Modern Earthy Noto Serif 21 / 400), uppercase, 3.5% letter spacing. components.name: Show More Affordance
components.description: Show More / Load More button below a block or feed: a rule with a notch and a centered uppercase label. Standalone, freely resizable; Label text property ("Show More Photos" in Photos Block, "Load More" on section fronts and in the For You feed).
rules: **Production values on purpose (Karl, 2026-10-23):** no component tokens. The colors below are raw hex. A tokens version (`3634:49427`) is kept only as the future target (design-vs-production entry 18, on hold); don't use it yet.
**Rule:** 1px along the top, full width. Rule and notch edges are a different gray per theme: `#D7D6D2` Bold Coastal (the Figma component), `#C8C4C0` Measured Vibrant, `#DDD8D5` Modern Earthy.
**Notch:** 35px `#FBFBFB` square with 1px left and bottom edges, rotated −45° and centered on the rule, about 5px right of center (as in production).
**Label:** Noto Sans Bold 16 / 16, uppercase, `color/theme/primary`, centered.
**Padding:** 40px above the label (below the rule) and 40px below it; 97px tall.
**States (production's, not variants):** hover, label `#0A0908`; keyboard focus, 2px black outline with a 5px offset.
**Width:** fills its column at every width.
knownIssues: Off-token by decision: the notch sits about 5px right of center and the colors aren't tokens (design-vs-production entry 18, on hold).
components.production: Production `.load-more` / `.show-more-videos`, every width (checked on all 6 review sites, 2026-10-27).

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Two types in one set. Type=Tooltip: a short hover/focus label for icon-only buttons (Label property). Type=Toggletip: an explanation opened by clicking or tapping an info button (Text property; Show Close). Placement = Top, Bottom.
rules: **Tooltip:** `color/gray/100` box, `radius/sm`; label Noto Sans Regular 12 (`font/size/12`), `color/gray/max` (11.6:1), line height auto; 4px (`spacing/050`) top and bottom, 8px (`spacing/100`) left and right; hugs its text up to 240px, then wraps. Never holds links or anything interactive; not shown on touch.

**Toggletip:** 275px wide, `color/gray/max`, 1px `color/gray/300` border, `radius/sm`; text Noto Sans Regular 13 (`font/size/13`), `color/gray/100`; 12px (`spacing/150`) around the text; Button In-Line Close (40×40) at the top right when Show Close is on (default).

**Caret:** 12×6, centered on the box, pointing at the trigger (Top: caret down; Bottom: caret up). The toggletip caret has a 1px `color/gray/300` edge. It overlaps the box by 1px so no seam shows. It scales with the component.
**Shadow:** `shadow/lg` on both types.
**Placement:** centered on the trigger, 8px (`spacing/100`) between the trigger and the caret tip; flip to the other Placement when there isn't room.

**Behavior:** Tooltip shows on hover or focus and hides on mouse-out, blur or Esc. Toggletip: the trigger is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (matching the popup's id); it opens on click or tap; Esc, the close button or a click outside closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.
**First use:** the For You feed header info button (Section Title / Eyebrow, Show Info) opens Type=Toggletip, Placement=Bottom.
knownIssues: Production's article "type of work" popup is the same pattern with off-token values and a broken `aria-controls` (design-vs-production entry 35).

components.name: Masthead
components.description: The site header on every WordPress page. Page = Home, SectionFront, Article, Obituaries, Dashboard; State = Default (top of the page, with ads), AdFree (top of the page, subscriber), Scrolled (sticky condensed bar, logged out), AdFree-Scrolled (sticky condensed bar, subscriber); Device = the 5 WordPress grid widths. Built from SectionMenu, AccountMenu (UserStatus inside), Weather Bug, SocialButtons and Ad Blocks.
rules: **Bar:** `color/gray/max`; every variant ends in a 1px `color/gray/400` rule (production #9D9A98, design-vs-production 9.3).

**Below 1040px:** one 64px row: hamburger (SectionMenu) left, logo centered, account icon or avatar (AccountMenu) and search right. The Top Leaderboard sits under the rule: 970x250 at 800–1039px and 728x90 at 640–799px with 16px (`spacing/200`) around it; 320x50 at 360px and 320x100 at 340px with 8px (`spacing/100`) around it.

**1040px and up, top of the page:** a 64px menus row (All Sections left; Subscribe / Log In or the avatar, then search, 40px `spacing/500` right padding); the weather, date and logo row with Sponsorship 1 320x50 (8px `spacing/100` top and bottom, 40px `spacing/500` sides); the Top Nav (16px `spacing/200` top and bottom, items 32px `spacing/400` apart, centered); the rule; the Trending row (8px top and bottom, 40px sides, 32px apart); then the Top Leaderboard 970x250 with 16px above and below.

**Type:** Top Nav items Noto Sans Bold 16 `color/gray/min` (18.4:1). Trending label Noto Sans Bold 14 uppercase `color/theme/primary` (4.75:1 or more on every site; 5.5:1 Bold Coastal); Trending items Noto Sans Regular 15 `color/gray/min`. Section front: the section name under the logo.

**Top Nav overflow:** the row keeps its natural width and is clipped at both edges when a site has more items than fit (11 on Chicago Tribune and Orlando Sentinel), as production does (design-vs-production 9.1).

**Scroll (Scrolled / AdFree-Scrolled):** after about 450px of scrolling (production adds `.headroom--not-top`) the masthead becomes a 64px bar fixed to the top of the viewport, with the rule and `shadow/masthead` (0 3px 3px, black 25%, production's value). The ads under it scroll away. No shadow at the top of the page. On articles at 1040px and up the bar shows the section name, headline and share buttons instead of All Sections / Subscribe / Log In.

**Subscribers (AdFree, AdFree-Scrolled):** no ads; the avatar (AccountMenu, loggedIn) replaces Subscribe / Log In. Below 1040px the subscriber bar is the same at the top and when scrolled. AdFree-Scrolled for Home, Section Front and Article added 2026-10-30 (Karl).

**Accessibility:** a `header` landmark with the section links in a `nav` (aria-label "Main"); the hamburger is a button with aria-expanded; search is a labelled button. Keep focused elements clear of the sticky bar (scroll-padding-top 65px).

**Obituaries title:** centered horizontally and vertically in its row at every width (Karl, 2026-10-30). Ads show wherever ads are expected: in Default, Sponsorship 1 300x50 sits to the right of the title at 800px and up and in its own centered row under the title below 800px; AdFree hides it.

components.description: Ad slot placeholders: one variant per production ad unit and size (Name), with Device = Desktop, Mobile or All. Units: Sponsorship 1, Top Leaderboard, Sponsorship 2, Cube 1 RRail ATF, Cube 2 RRail Mid, Cube 3 RRail Lower, Cube Article, Sidebar Rectangle, Outstream Video, Mid-Article Banner, Bottom Leaderboard, Mobile Adhesion, plus PLACE HOLDER (not an ad unit).
rules: **Box:** the unit's exact size, never scaled. #85FF9B fill (placeholder art, not a token), 2px `color/gray/min` border, X diagonals in 2px #111111 (placeholder art). Label: Noto Serif Bold 16 with 10% letter spacing, "<unit> <size>" over "ADVERTISEMENT", `color/gray/min` with a 3px `color/gray/600` halo, centered, 8px (`spacing/100`) apart.
**Production:** an empty Google Publisher Tag container (div) the size of the unit, centered in its slot. The slot keeps the unit's height so the page doesn't jump when the creative loads.

**Production slots:** Sponsorship 1 `sponsorship_1`; Top Leaderboard `top_leaderboard`; Sponsorship 2 `sponsorship_2` / `_3` / `_4`; Cube 1 / 2 / 3 `cube1_rrail_atf` / `cube2_rrail_mid` / `cube3_rrail_lower`; Cube Article `cube_article`; Outstream Video `outstream_video`; Bottom Leaderboard `bottom_leaderboard`; Mobile Adhesion `mobile_adhesion`. rules: **Band:** `color/gray/600` throughout, 1px `color/gray/black` rule at the top; the newspaper logo (235×48) starts the content.

**1040px and up:** 40px (`spacing/500`) sides, 16px (`spacing/200`) top and bottom; 5 columns 32px (`spacing/400`) apart: [Subscribe, Marketplace] | [Stay Informed, About] | [Advertising] | [Contact, Partners] | [Subscribe Now]. 800–1039px: 3 columns [Subscribe, Marketplace] | [Stay Informed, About, Advertising] | [Contact, Partners, Subscribe Now]; 640–799px: 2 columns [Subscribe, Marketplace, Stay Informed, About] | [Advertising, Contact, Partners, Subscribe Now].

**Link group:** 2px `color/gray/min` rule, heading Noto Sans Bold 16 uppercase, links Noto Sans Regular 16, all `color/gray/min` (16.0:1 on `color/gray/600`), 16px (`spacing/200`) apart (production's Footer has 15px).
**Stay Informed:** heading Noto Sans Bold 16 uppercase, "Email Address" label Noto Sans Regular 16, then a Form Field (email) with the mail icon.
**Legal bar:** 1px `color/gray/min` rule above; links Noto Sans Regular 16 `color/gray/200` (5.7:1), wrapping.
